text_block_list.text:
Check it out, Grass! I'm lookin' as ripped
as a
wrestler!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oh wow, you really are. You've been
taking your
weight lifting seriously.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Sí! I think I've been shapin' up nicely!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I gotta keep my body tuned if I'm gonna
get hella
fast!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm really glad your diet has been
going well.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
D-d-diet... Who said anything about a
diet?
...Hahaha!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, silly me. It's not like you would
ever
overindulged on limited-time-only
omelets and
gain too much weight.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Oops, it's just about time for my die—I
mean,
weight lifting! See ya!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Through dieting... or weight lifting
rather, El
Condor Pasa has successfully
lost some weight.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
